_comment: Cargo hold upgrade levels, in order (the first entry is level 0). capacity_mult multiplies inventory.capacity (default 100 cargo units): 100 / 200 / 400 / 800. Phase 5 crafting raises the level (gameplay::IInventory::setLevel). Items may also carry an optional 'volume' in data/items.json (cargo units per item, default 1); ores take 1 unit each.
